---
name: 🐞 Bug report
about: Something isn't working as expected.
title: "[bug] "
labels: bug
---

## Describe the bug

A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## To reproduce

A minimal `.ezhtml` file (paste here or attach) that reproduces the
behaviour:

```ezhtml
title "…"
```

## Expected behaviour

What you expected to see.

## Actual behaviour

What happened instead. Include the exact output of `ezhtml build … --report`
or the editor's status bar.

## Environment

```text
$ ezhtml version        # paste output here
$ uname -a              # or `ver` on Windows
```

## Additional context

Anything else that may help.

## Security

- [ ] This is **not** a security issue. (For security issues see `SECURITY.md`.)
